messages:
anita: Hey infra team :wave: Can someone take a quick look at a tiny TF change I have for the VPC routing between gpu-pool and natgw? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — mostly a route table attachment and a small cidr fix. Hoping to merge in the next canary window (tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT).

matt: @anita pinged. I'll grab it in a bit. Can you paste the relevant TF snippet here?

anita: Sure — snippet below. It's literally adding the `route_table_association` and fixing a cidr var that was wrong.

```hcl
resource "aws_route_table_association" "gpu_subnet_rt_assoc" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.gpu_subnet.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.gpu_rt.id
}

variable "gpu_subnet_cidr" {
  default = "10.40.96.0/19" # changed from /20 to /19 to match plan
}
```

zach: :eyes: Can you run `terraform plan -var 'gpu_subnet_cidr=10.40.96.0/19'` in the canary workspace and paste the plan output? Want to confirm no destroy of unrelated resources.

anita: Ran it and trimmed the noise — plan shows just create association and no deletes. Paste: 

```
Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ aws_route_table_association.gpu_subnet_rt_assoc

No other changes.
```

infra-bot: [CI] all checks passed for PR #482 — plan ran in canary workspace — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/plan/482

matt: Quick read-through — looks good. One tiny nit: use `depends_on = [aws_subnet.gpu_subnet]` on the association to avoid race in applies in large canary clusters. Can you add it?

anita: Good call, adding it now.

anita: Updated PR with depends_on. Also added a short comment explaining the cidr change.

lee: Skimmed — :thumbsup: from me if infra-bot plan still clean after update.

infra-bot: [CI] re-run plan succeeded for PR #482 — Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

jordan: Are we okay to merge in the 09:00-10:00 PT canary window tomorrow? Any risk to memecache clusters in that region?

zach: No memecache impact. This only touches gpu-subnet routing. Canary window fine.

matt: approved. Please squash-and-merge after the canary window starts, and monitor the routing health dashboard for 10m.

lee: approved.

anita: Thanks all — I'll merge at 09:05 PT tomorrow and follow the checklist. Will post a quick follow-up here after the merge. :rocket:
